lines.en: I head home early to spend some time with Ami.
lines.zh: 我提早回了家，想陪 Ami 待一会儿。

lines.en: She's already in her pajamas when I get back, so the two of us spend the night eating pizza and watching movies on the couch.
lines.zh: 我到家时她已经换上睡衣了，于是我俩人窝在沙发上，吃披萨、看电影，就这么过了一晚。

lines.en: And when I say 'watching movies,' I really mean that {i}I{/i} am the one watching movies. Or trying to, at least.
lines.zh: 我说的「看电影」，其实是指{i}我{/i}在看电影。至少是在努力看。

lines.en: Ami sits there and playfully squeezes my arm, trying to get me to pay attention to her the entire time.
lines.zh: Ami 就坐在那儿，一边玩闹地捏我的胳膊，一边全程想让我把注意力放到她身上。

lines.en: Having a weakness for cute girls, I obviously wind up focusing on her instead and completely neglect whatever movie we were 'watching' in the first place.
lines.zh: 我对可爱女孩向来没什么抵抗力，结果当然是把注意力全放在她身上，完全无视了我们原本「在看」的那部电影。

lines.en: Ami eventually falls asleep on my shoulder and I have to carry her to her bedroom.
lines.zh: Ami 最后靠在我肩上睡着了，我只好把她抱回她的卧室。

lines.en: As I lay her down and begin to walk away, she unconsciously reaches out and grabs my hand to prevent me from leaving.
lines.zh: 我把她放下、正要走开，她无意识地伸出手抓住我，不让我离开。

lines.en: After a while, she becomes too tired to hang on and I'm left with no other option but to call it a night...
lines.zh: 过了一会儿，她实在困得抓不住了，我也就只能就此结束这一天……
